note: Agent Workers — BUILT, VERIFIED, LIVE. Ten pieces (BEA-1386→1395) plus the re-verification fixes (BEA-1401), all shipped to main and deployed. Design: specs/AGENT-WORKERS.md; briefs in specs/briefs/. Owner decisions 2026-08-22: two repair attempts, 12h question deadline, Brightdata/Apify AFTER (BEA-1397). PROVEN on the owner's real agent 743d0852 at ZERO credits for the comparison (3 credits for the whole acceptance): 41/41 cells identical to the plan runner; a corrupted saved answer caught, repaired by Codex and promoted with 0 vendor calls; ask-and-wait resumed 12s after a real WhatsApp reply with no repeated fetch/write/message. STILL OFF: all NINE agents are useWorker:false — the worker road is dormant until the owner switches one on. NEEDS THE OWNER (root, one time): mkdir -p /srv/mybrain-workers + chown sandy:sandy; copy services/host/mybrain-worker-runner.service to /etc/systemd/system; write /home/sandy/worker-runner/runner.env (0600) with WORKER_RUNNER_TOKEN; daemon-reload; enable --now. Until then the runner runs by hand (port 8769, WORKER_ROOT=/home/sandy/worker-root) and dies on reboot — a switched-on agent then falls back to the plan runner and says so. Deferred by decision: BEA-1396 tappable WhatsApp buttons, BEA-1397 Brightdata/Apify.
